faqs.q: How much does a new roof cost?
faqs.a: Every Houston-area roof is different, and so is the cost of replacement. We take several factors into consideration: size, old roof tear-off, roof style, shape, your selected materials — shingle, tile, metal, slate, cedar shake — and other features like chimneys, skylights and vents that we need to work around. A replacement roof is a big investment, and giving a quote without examining your unique situation would not be in your best interest.

faqs.q: How do I know if I need a new roof?
faqs.a: Sometimes the answer is obvious: loose or missing flashing around roof penetrations, missing shingles, leaks, or critters taking up residence in your attic. Other times the signs are more subtle. If your roof is more than 12 to 15 years old, it may be time to get a replacement and get ahead of any problems that result from a damaged roof.

faqs.q: Should I replace my roof before I list my home?
faqs.a: According to Better Homes and Gardens, a whopping 40% of a home's curb appeal is due to the condition and aesthetic of the roof. If your roof is in bad shape or in need of major repairs, you may have a lot of trouble getting people to bid on your home. A lot of buyers these days are on a budget and do not want to spend money on major repairs just after buying a house. Replacing your roof before you sell can help you get ahead of trouble while still recouping most, if not all, of the costs when you sell.

services.title: Roof Repairs and Insurance Claims
services.short: Repairs, storm damage and help with the claim.
services.text: Roof maintenance and repairs are essential to the longevity of your roof and dramatically reduce the likelihood of leaks. We also know the storm damage insurance claims process.
services.imageAlt: Angel Oliveros of H Town Roof & Constructions standing on a shingle roof
body: Roof maintenance and repairs are essential to the longevity of your roof, and they dramatically reduce the likelihood of roof leaks. H Town Roof & Constructions detects developing threats to the integrity of your roof and preemptively addresses repairs, saving you money by avoiding major structural or system damage.

Hail damage takes the form of circular indentations which can penetrate to the underlayment, and hail also loosens the shingles' protective surface granules. It can lead to roof leaks if it is not addressed promptly, and we can identify it during a thorough roof inspection.

Strong East Texas winds lift and peel off shingles, causing them to break or dislodge and exposing the underlying structure of the roof. Missing or damaged shingles raise the risk of moisture penetrating into the roofing deck and attic space, where it collects inside the rafters and insulation and promotes bacterial growth, which is a health hazard.

Aging roofs often have shingles with turned up edges, giving most of the shingle surface a concave shape. Curling shingles diminish the appearance of your roof, and if a significant number of them are curling and we are unable to flatten them, they should be replaced. If they are curling so badly that we cannot repair them properly, we recommend replacement.
Plus we know the storm damage insurance claims process and will help you get the appropriate payout.
points: Hail strikes and loosened shingle granules
Wind damage from strong East Texas storms
Missing and damaged shingles replaced

about.title: A family-owned Houston contractor
text: At H Town Roof & Constructions, our journey began over five years ago when Angel Oliveros started as a door-to-door roof salesman. In that role, Angel witnessed firsthand the misinformation regarding the complex process of making a home insurance claim, and that experience inspired him to shift his focus towards education, by becoming a certified property inspector in the state of Texas.

With a passion for serving the Houston community and a commitment to empowering homeowners with knowledge, Angel began recruiting family members and skilled technicians to establish a family-owned business.

H Town Roof & Constructions is your quality-focused, one-stop shop for comprehensive interior and exterior construction solutions, and we are quickly building a well-deserved reputation for honesty, craftsmanship and fair pricing.
